import subprocess
import sys

try:
    result = subprocess.run(["inventory-release-check", "--project", "."], check=False)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Release verifier unavailable: inventory-release-check is not installed.", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(69) from None
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
